title: Crop Insurance Claims Servicing Standards Card
content:
Seventy-two hours, fifteen calendar days and five business days are the Crop Insurance claim servicing figures, alongside the loss provisions each plan and coverage level switches on.

## Notice and adjuster figures

| Plan and coverage level | Notice of loss after discovering damage | Written notice | Adjuster assigned after a notice of loss | Production and claim records kept |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | within 72 hours | 15 calendar days | 5 business days | 3 years |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | within 72 hours | 15 calendar days | 5 business days | 3 years |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | within 72 hours | 15 calendar days | 5 business days | 3 years |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | within 72 hours | 15 calendar days | 5 business days | 3 years |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | within 72 hours | 15 calendar days | 5 business days | 3 years |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | within 72 hours | 15 calendar days | 5 business days | 3 years |

- **Notice of loss** — Hours after discovering damage within which notice of loss must be given.
- **Written notice** — Calendar days after the end of the insurance period, or after damage on harvested acreage, by which written notice must be given.
- **Adjuster assignment** — Business days after a notice of loss within which a loss adjuster is assigned.
- **Records** — Years production and claim records must be kept.

## Loss provisions switched on by level

| Plan and coverage level | Quality adjustment | Hail and fire exclusion |
|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | No | No |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | Yes | No |

- **Quality adjustment** — whether quality-damaged production is adjusted under the quality loss provisions.
- **Hail and fire exclusion** — whether hail and fire may be excluded with a private hail policy in force.

## Points of judgement

- Quality-damaged production is adjusted under the quality loss provisions at every Revenue Protection level and not at Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT).
- Hail and fire may be excluded, with a private hail policy in force, at Revenue Protection 65%, 70%, 75% and 80% Coverage; the exclusion is not available at Revenue Protection 85% Coverage or at Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT).
- Hypothetical timing: damage discovered at 6 a.m. on a Monday falls within the 72-hour notice window until 6 a.m. on the Thursday that follows.
